newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Dec PMI index falls to 44.7 pct from 52.8.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Dec PMI index falls to 44.7 pct from 52.8.

text.p: Hungary's Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) was 44.7 percent in December, down from 52.8 percent in November, the Hungarian Association of Logistics, Purchasing and Inventory Management (HALPIM) said on Wednesday.
The following is a history of the index over the year on a month-to-month basis:

NOTE: The PMI is calculated using the same methodology as the United States' National Association of Purchasing Management Index. A figure above 50 indicates increasing economic activity, while a number below 50 shows declining economic activity.

HALPIM said that the fall of the PMI in December was due to seasonal factors, indicating the usual year-end reduction in activity in processing industry. But it added the December PMI was above the December 1995 figure of 35.9 percent.
